name: NanoMenu
tagline: A featherweight overlay menu for Minecraft 1.20+.
description:
## NanoMenu

A **tiny, fast** overlay menu for Minecraft `1.20+`. No config screens, no bloat.

- Opens with a single keybind
- Remembers your last menu
- Works client-side only

```
Drop nanomenu-2.4.jar into /mods and launch.
```

Made for people who like their UI **quiet**.

name: PixelDesk
tagline: A minimal always-on-top widget board for your desktop.
description:
## PixelDesk

Widgets that stay **out of your way**: clock, notes, and a tiny launcher.

- Transparent glass widgets
- Zero installer — unzip and run
- Remembers layout per monitor

name: TapLaunch
tagline: Gesture launcher for Android — two taps to anything.
description:
## TapLaunch

Replace your home screen with **two taps**.

1. Draw a gesture
2. The app opens

No accounts, no ads, no permissions beyond the obvious.

name: HashDrop
tagline: Drag a file, get every checksum instantly. Windows build.
description:
## HashDrop

**MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256** in one drop.

- Right-click context menu entry
- Compare mode with `expected` paste box
- Portable mode with `--portable`

name: quickfetch
description:
## quickfetch

System info in **under 50ms**.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://example.com/quickfetch/install.sh | sh
```

Works on Linux, macOS, and WSL. Pipe it, alias it, forget it.
